newsitem.title: USA: USDA buys 360,000 lbs frozen hams for schools.
newsitem.headline: USDA buys 360,000 lbs frozen hams for schools.

text.p: The Agricultural Marketing Service of the U.S. Department of Agriculture said it bought 360,000 pounds of frozen smoked fully cooked hams for use in the National School Lunch Program.

AMS said it bought the hams at prices ranging from $1.8515 to $1.9350 per lb. Cumulative purchases since the program was announced August 19 total 1.8 million lbs at a cost of $3.4 million. Shipments are scheduled for October 13-26, 1996.
Winning bidders were Clougherty Packing Co (Los Angeles CA) 108,000 lbs and Prepared Foods Inc (Santa Teresa NM) 252,000 lbs.
